coaching.title: Today's Run
coaching.message: Easy 8–10 miles, Z2 only (130–140 bpm), no vert work. Your resting HR is 71—elevated 6.5 bpm above your 30-day average—and your recovery score sits at 53/100 (moderate), which signals incomplete parasympathetic rebound. With 49 days to Kranjska Gora, you're in taper now; this is a shakeout day ahead of tomorrow's long run, not a workout day. Keep it conversational, stay below 10 min/mile, and treat this as a neuromuscular activation pass. You've run hard the last three days (21.21 mi at 145 bpm mid-week); today's job is to flush and prepare.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You're in taper with reduced daily volume; don't cut calories aggressively or you'll compromise tomorrow's long run and weekend recovery. Aim for 55–60g carbs during the run (6–8 oz sports drink or 1–2 gels depending on duration), then within 30 minutes post-run consume 25–30g protein + 60–80g carbs to arrest the cortisol spike from your elevated resting HR. Your sleep efficiency was solid at 92.4% last night—protect that tonight with a 7:00 pm dinner cutoff and 500 ml electrolyte fluid across the evening to combat travel dehydration.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Your sleep volume (8.21h) is good, but the +6.5 bpm resting HR rise is a red flag for incomplete ANS recovery. Prioritize sleep *timing*—aim for 10:00 pm bedtime tonight to secure 8+ hours before Saturday's long run. No ice baths today; stick to easy mobility (10 min hip/glute work) and consider a 6–8 minute sauna if accessible post-run to shift parasympathetic tone. Hydration is likely your limiting factor given work travel; shoot for 3+ liters of water today beyond your run fluids.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Taper is a mental game. You have 49 days and a clean taper ahead—resist the urge to 'squeeze in' extra volume or intensity. The Julian Alps 50K will demand 6–7 hours of sustained climbing on technical terrain with sparse aid; Saturday's long run is your last major stimulus, so stay disciplined with today's easy effort and use it to build confidence in your aerobic base. Your last three weeks have shown solid fitness (21-miler at race-relevant HR). Trust the plan.
